role: Fresh short-lived FIRST text-only composition/adjudication of retained independent SOURCE204 and SOURCE205 observations; not a pixel re-review or permanent/replacement A-D.

scope.question: Do the independently observed SOURCE204 tail and SOURCE205 onset support separate prose objects, without string joining, and only a derived scoped view clearing p0204#3.open?

independence_definition: The criterion and present judgment are independent of author repair, author expectations, counters, and any new pixel reading. Primary observations were read in the requested order before source-object semantics. This criterion is frozen after those reads, not falsely described as blind or pre-observation, and before any adjudication report or derived projection.

semantic_contracts.rule: p is a prose paragraph; open means this typed object is unfinished; cont continues the prior same-kind object; footer is transparent; section allocation is distinct from paragraph merging.

Only a qualifying open/cont pair merges lines and spans. With a cross-page open predecessor and non-cont successor, lines 93-94 warn and line 95 preserves a separate block. A warning is not independent evidence of continuity or section completion.

pass_requires_all.rule: All five supplied SHA-256 pins match the retained text bytes; the scope-relevant observations remain identifiable as independent pixel findings, including qualifications.

Independent SOURCE204 observations explicitly identify the final equation as complete on that page and identify only the separate footer afterward. Formula familiarity, absence of punctuation, and metadata alone cannot establish paragraph closure.

Independent SOURCE205 observations explicitly identify first-row indentation relative to subsequent rows and a new explanatory paragraph naming the preceding relations, rather than a split sentence or split formula. The full accepted first paragraph must remain unchanged.

Use C2 together with C3 under the typed paragraph contract to judge the boundary. Conservative unobserved-next-page open metadata is not contradictory pixel evidence, and topical continuation of section 77 is not continuation of the same paragraph.

Any proposed scoped assembly view is bound to the original faithful page JSON hashes and copies p0204#3, its intervening footer, and p0205#1 without changing text, formulas, line breaks, punctuation, emphasis, or block identities. Its only source-block field delta is p0204#3.open true to false. It does not execute assembly or modify original files.

Original d586 SOURCE204205_JOIN remains HOLD with its exact blocking list; d575 original conservative open and old reports remain unchanged. No whole-n77 completion/signature, new-content approval, author repair, repair-budget reset, canonical edit, native pipeline invocation, Git, DB, deploy, or image opening occurs.

hold_rule: If a required pin fails, a relevant observation is absent or contradictory, the two sides cannot distinguish a paragraph continuation from a new paragraph, payload identity cannot be preserved, or scope retention fails, record genuine HOLD with the precise blocking evidence and omit any executable closure projection. Never fill a gap with formula familiarity or metadata.
freeze_policy: Seal criterion.json 0444 and obtain its full SHA-256 receipt before creating report.json or any derived projection. Never amend this criterion during the batch.
